There would appear to be multiple (obvious / discernible) revisions / :manufacturers / clones of this adapter.
The original may have no LEDs, a solid black plastic casing, and likely :solely uses 00:E0:4C (''[[Realtek]]'') OUIs. Another type would appear to have an always-on blue LED which shines :through the semi-translucent red band on dongle (looks ''kind'' of cool). At least some of these use E8:4E:06 (''EDUP'') OUIs.
